accepted_scope: Actual pinned Prost bytes::merge and Vec<u8>::replace_with/put on valid contiguous byte buffers, under successful bounded allocation below isize::MAX; content/error/suffix/duplicate semantics only.
review_notes: Pinned Rust bytes::merge checks the wire type first, decodes a uint64 length, rejects underflow before copying, then calls replace_with on the consumed prefix. Proofs retain exact errors and remaining suffixes.

Actual extracted Vec<u8> replacement clears, reserves, then calls the actual extracted Vec::put loop. The proof handles empty input and a complete contiguous chunk; it does not replace this function with a trusted success Boolean or an assumed replacement equality.
Bytes content views match pinned remaining/chunk/advance/split_to on valid buffers; prefix/suffix equality ignores reference counts, pointer identity, capacity and allocation behavior.

Generic external model definitions are accepted only for their reviewed U8/contiguous instantiations. The reserve model checks usize rather than Rust isize capacity; its use is justified only with the external successful bounded allocation precondition. No theorem about all Rust Vec values or arbitrary Drop is accepted.

Trait projection preserves remaining/chunk/advance, uses the actual default has_remaining behavior, and leaves unobserved BytesAdapter methods universally quantified. No unused dummy method is used to infer replacement correctness.

Previously accepted total varint proofs replay against exactly identical computational bodies. The bytes_full_reference theorem has no caller-supplied decoder/replacement equality premise. Later successful duplicate fields overwrite, including empty replacement.
All 20 rebuilt object hashes match the frozen report. Fresh audits of 92 endpoints plus a separate 26-endpoint audit use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
